subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps with Zenora
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Thompson <arielle@zenora.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-18T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration discussion

Hi Arielle,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps:

Summary of pain points
- Latency spikes on customer-facing chat during peak traffic (esp. inferencing on long contexts)
- High per-token cost for reranking flows used in search & recommendations
- Need for structured outputs for downstream analytics and policy checks

Goals
- Reduce 95th-percentile response latency below 500ms for key endpoints
- Cut reranking token costs by 30% while preserving precision
- Get an internal pilot running with function-calling and streaming enabled by end of month

Integration & product fit notes
- SDK: we recommend using the Redwood JS SDK (v1.3+) — small breaking change to streaming API: new stream() helper. We can provide a migration patch.
- Function calling: Redwood supports function/schema calling; we'll map your existing intent schemas to structured outputs. This will help with deterministic actions from the model.
- Streaming & structured outputs: Streaming is supported over WebSockets or SSE; structured JSON outputs can be validated server-side via our post-processing hooks.
- Embeddings & reranking: Use batch embeddings (quantized) + our reranker blueprint to lower token usage — we can share sample eval prompts.

Action items
1) I'll send an integration spec and a short SDK diff for your engineers (Rafael cc'd) — due tomorrow.
2) Schedule a technical workshop with your LLM engineer (Liam) — propose Wed/Thu next week.
3) Provide a small sample of your reranking prompt set (5–10 examples) so we can baseline cost/accuracy.

Next steps: Are you OK with the proposed plan? If yes, I'll attach the spec and draft MA (for initial POC).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-integration-spec.pdf (summary + SDK diff)

From: Arielle Thompson <arielle@zenora.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Park <liam@zenora.ai>
Date: 2027-08-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration discussion

Thanks Marissa — this is perfect, appreciate the clear plan.

Quick answers:
- Latency: yes, 95th currently sits ~820ms during daily peaks. Our priority is the chat endpoint.
- Reranking: current pipeline uses OpenAI API; cost is our main blocker.
- Structured outputs: we need strict JSON schema for actions (create_ticket, escalate_to_agent, suggest_article).

We'll share the 10 reranking samples by EOD Monday. Liam's technical availability looks best Thursday morning PST for the workshop.

Please send the integration spec and the MA draft.

Cheers,
Arielle

--
Arielle Thompson
Head of Product
Zenora Solutions
arielle@zenora.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Thompson <arielle@zenora.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Liam Park <liam@zenora.ai>
Date: 2027-08-20T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood integration spec + SDK diff (attached)

Hi Arielle — attaching the spec and the draft MA as discussed. Highlights below and a quick integration checklist for your engineers.

Attachment: redwood-integration-spec.pdf, ma-draft-zenora.docx

Integration highlights:
- SDK migration: The streaming helper changes are minimal — example patch included in the spec (see section 2). Example snippet:
  const stream = await redwood.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', input });
  for await (const chunk of stream) { /* render partials */ }

- Function calling: We'll onboard your three action schemas into Redwood. Recommended: enforce strict JSON schema server-side and use our function signature binding to reduce hallucinations.

- Streaming + structured outputs: Use SSE for browser clients (lower overhead) and WebSocket for long-lived agent sessions. Both support early token trimming and partial JSON validation.

- Embeddings & reranking: Run a small offline eval (we can do this) using your 10 examples; we'll return a cost/precision baseline and a suggested quantization profile.

Technical workshop proposal:
- Attendees: Liam (LLM eng), your backend lead, Rafael (solutions eng), Marissa (AM)
- Duration: 60–90 minutes
- Agenda: architecture review, SDK walkthrough, function-calling mapping, sample rerank eval plan

Action items (updated)
- Zenora: share 10 reranking examples (Arielle) — EOD Mon 2027-08-23
- Redwood: run quick offline eval + share baseline report — deliverable by 2027-08-26
- Schedule workshop: propose Thu 2027-08-26 10:00AM PST — confirm availability

If that timeline works, Rafael and I will coordinate a short solutions-eng prep call beforehand.

Thanks — attaching files now.

Best,
Marissa

--
redwood-integration-spec.pdf (contains SDK diff, migration steps, sample JSON schemas)
ma-draft-zenora.docx (POC scope + standard MA terms)
